name: e-NAM: National Agriculture Market (Sell Online)
summary: A government online market that links mandis across the country, so your produce is bid for by many buyers and payment comes straight to your bank account.

benefits.headline: Competitive online bidding and direct bank payment
details: Registered buyers from your state and beyond bid for your lot online, which improves price discovery.
Payment is made electronically into your bank account, typically within a couple of working days.

summary: Any farmer can register, and you sell at an e-NAM-integrated mandi (APMC).
Your registration is approved by your local mandi (APMC) after document verification.

steps: Go to enam.gov.in (or the e-NAM mobile app), choose Registration, select 'Farmer' and pick your nearest mandi (APMC).
Enter your personal, land and bank details and upload your documents.
Your mandi (APMC) verifies the application. You then receive a permanent Farmer Login ID and password.
Take your produce to the e-NAM mandi. It is graded and listed, buyers bid online, and the payment is credited to your account when you accept.

deadline.text: Register any time. Do it before harvest so your login is ready when you want to sell.

caveats: Prices are discovered through bidding and are not guaranteed. e-NAM is not a Minimum Support Price scheme.
